title: ctenopteris apiculata
intro: Ctenopteris apiculata, commonly known as the New Zealand fan fern, is a plant species belonging to the family Dryopteridaceae. The New Zealand fan fern has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions include wound healing, antispasmodic, and anti-cancer properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. While more research is needed to fully understand its effects, the New Zealand fan fern has shown promise in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits.
